controls.title: Git
controls.command: if command -v lazygit >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec lazygit; else git status --short --branch; fi

controls.title: Amber API
controls.command: PATH="$HOME/.homebrew/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH" uv run --extra app amber api serve

controls.title: Marimo Notebooks
controls.command: export PATH="/Applications/cmux.app/Contents/Resources/bin:$HOME/.homebrew/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; (for attempt in {1..120}; do curl -fs http://127.0.0.1:2718 >/dev/null && { cmux browser open http://127.0.0.1:2718 --window "$CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID" --focus true; exit; }; sleep 0.25; done) & exec uv run marimo edit --headless --no-token --host 127.0.0.1 --port 2718

controls.title: Quality
controls.command: export PATH="$HOME/.homebrew/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"; uv run --extra dev ruff check . && uv run --extra dev ruff format --check . && uv run --extra dev mypy src && uv run marimo check notebooks/scratch.py
